title: Place Value Worksheets: Tens and Ones Expanded Form
intro: Teach a ten as a group of ten ones.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Bundle ten counters and place loose ones beside them. Connect the model to the two digits and to an expanded-form sum.

Example to work through together

Use the model below as you explain the example. Have your student point to the quantities as you discuss them.

23 = 20 + 3

Two groups of ten have a value of 20. The three remaining ones have a value of 3.

Ask your student

Why does the left digit represent tens?

If your student needs help

If the student counts each bundle as one object, open a bundle and count the ten ones inside.

Choosing and using the worksheet

Each set shows six distinct numerals from 10 through 99. Children write the tens value plus the ones value. The printable uses numerals rather than pictures of bundles; provide objects or base-ten blocks when the child still needs a physical model. A set does not guarantee a teen number or a zero ones digit.
